Tap a suburb to zoom to it.

Knocked and answered count enrolled street addresses (a block of units is one address) with at least one knock, or at least one conversation or busy answer. Support is supporters (4–5) per answered door, one result per enrolled dwelling, with each volunteer's scoring habits removed so every area is scored as if the district's usual mix of volunteers knocked it. The ± figure is a 95% margin of error.
